# Constitution Governance

The BottleBazaar rewrite uses contract-first, compliance-by-default governance with reversible delivery.

## What Happened

For task t1, the existing repository documentation established Expo clients, an Express/PostgreSQL/Redis
baseline, in-store-only redemption, and excise safeguards. The constitution records the mandated Java/Spring
Boot rewrite and fresh schema while preserving compatible contracts and behavior.

## Takeaway

Treat API compatibility, server-side age/dry-day/licence enforcement, single-use QR redemption, and
runtime verification as release gates; do not equate source inventory with rewrite scope.

## History

- 2026-10-25 (BottleBazaar/t1): initial
